row.evidence: Resend's SSO docs say SSO "is available as an add-on on Scale plans, and included on Enterprise plans" and that users signing in through SSO are "added automatically with the Member role"; no SCIM is documented on any plan.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none); JIT-only via SSO, no SCIM endpoint (may be reclassified at merge). Change since June: SSO launched on 2026-09-01 as a $150/mo add-on to Scale ($90/mo+) and is included on Enterprise; June said Enterprise mentions SSO. With Enforce SSO, removing a user in the IdP removes them from the Resend team, but there is no SCIM or member-management API. Pricing is flat and volume-based (Free $0, Pro $20-$35, Scale $90-$1,150 per month) and billed monthly only, so per-user fields are null. The public REST API covers email, domains, contacts, webhooks, API keys and logs; it has no team member or user endpoints.

citations.title: Pricing · Resend
citations.quote: Let your team sign in to Resend with your identity provider. Available as an add-on on Scale plans, and included on Enterprise plans.

citations.title: Resend Pricing (markdown)
citations.quote: **Single Sign-On — $150 / mo**: Available as an add-on on Scale plans, and included on Enterprise plans.

citations.title: Resend Pricing (markdown)
citations.quote: Self-serve plans are billed monthly only. There are no annual plans and no discount for paying annually.

citations.title: Resend Pricing (markdown)
citations.quote: All plans include: RESTful API, SMTP relay, official SDKs, inbound emails, batch sending, open & link tracking, React Email, multi-region, DKIM/SPF/DMARC, webhooks, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR compliance, MFA, and API key permissions.

citations.title: Single Sign-On - Resend
citations.quote: SSO is available as an add-on on Scale plans, and included on Enterprise plans.

citations.title: Single Sign-On - Resend
citations.quote: Anyone who signs in through SSO and isn't yet a member of the team is added automatically with the **Member** role. No invitation is needed.

citations.title: Single Sign-On - Resend
citations.quote: With [**Enforce SSO**](#enforce-sso) turned on, your provider becomes the only way in, so removing someone there also removes their access to Resend.

citations.title: Managing Teams - Resend
citations.quote: Click **Invite**. Input an email address and select a role (**Admin** or **Member**).

citations.title: Single Sign-On · Resend Changelog
citations.quote: **Enforced**: users can only sign in through your IdP, and removing a user from the IdP removes them from your Resend team.

SSO protocol (SAML vs OIDC) and supported IdPs are not stated; setup opens an external configuration tab.
Whether 'Enforce SSO' removal happens at next sign-in or by sync from the IdP is not documented.
